parameters.content:
## 🚀 Instagram Daily Report — Single Page Setup Guide

### How This Workflow Works
Runs **daily at 23:59**, collects all Instagram posts from that day, fetches engagement insights (likes, comments, shares, saves, reach, views), and sends a formatted HTML report by email.

### ✅ One-Time Setup Checklist
1. **📝 Instagram Page Credentials node** — Enter your Access Token, Page ID, API version, and timezone offset.
2. **🗓️ Extract Date From Trigger node** — No edits needed. Date is auto-pulled from the schedule.
3. **⚙️ Config: Page & Date node** — No edits needed. Values flow in automatically.
4. **🎨 Build HTML Email Report node** — Update `recipientEmail` to your email address.
5. **📧 Send Report Email node** — Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential.

### 📅 Schedule
Fires every day at **23:59**. Adjust in the Schedule Trigger node if needed.

## 📝 STEP 1 — Instagram Credentials

Edit these fields in the node below:

**`accessToken`** — Your Instagram Page Access Token (long-lived). Get it from Meta Business Suite or Graph API Explorer.

**`pageId`** — Your Instagram Business Account ID (numeric, e.g. `17841400123456789`). Find it via: `graph.facebook.com/me?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN`

**`apiVersion`** — Facebook Graph API version. Default: `v1.0`

**`timezoneOffsetHours`** — UTC offset. Bangladesh = `6`, India = `5.5`, UAE = `4`, UK = `0`, EST = `-5`

⚠️ Use a long-lived or System User token to avoid expiry.

## 🗓️ STEP 2 — Auto Date Extraction

**No configuration needed here.**

This node automatically reads **Year**, **Month**, and **Day** from the Schedule Trigger output. The target date equals the day the workflow runs.

The timezone offset (set in Step 1) adjusts the UTC window used for filtering posts.

✅ Leave this node unchanged.

## 📧 STEP 3 — Email Recipient

Open the **🎨 Build HTML Email Report** node and update:

```js
const recipientEmail = 'your@email.com';
```

Replace `your@email.com` with the address that should receive the daily report.

Also ensure the **📧 Send Report Email** node has a valid **Gmail OAuth2** credential connected.

# You will get report in mail like this :

![Instagram Insights Report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashunterbd/n8n-screenshot/4a2ba0161ae1da86dfed19224f2f25c9f947ee7a/ig-daily-report.png)
